name: Porcelain
thesis: A cool ceramic reading sheet rests inside a frosted personal library, keeping the story still and the rest of the app outside its edges.
difference: Newsreader throughout; deep ink on pale blue ceramic; one rounded, vertically swiped sheet; session settings above it, an asymmetric source shelf and Saved control below, and personal settings at the top.
tradeoff: Sources and Saved stay close at hand, but their separation from session controls requires learning the spatial arrangement; the larger sheet also leaves less room for story imagery.
lens: Scandinavian industrial design: cool ceramic, frosted glass, crisp native controls, and a removable analog reading object.
